# The games of issues written by hand, before the issue form, and of issues whose game's name
# needs putting right: the issue's number, then the game, one game a line (an issue about two
# games has two lines). The game compatibility list (compatibility_list.py) lists each game by
# how its issue stands, as it lists the issues made with the form, whose "Game" field names
# it. A line here wins over that field: name the game as a report does, and the two are one
# row (names that differ only in case, punctuation, a leading "The" or Roman numerals are one
# game already).
